description: This Java class implements a no-operation (noop) version of a health check server, conforming to the HealthCheckServer interface. It provides stub methods for registering health check resources, starting, and stopping, primarily logging a warning during start and immediately succeeding futures for start and stop.

classes.name: NoopHealthCheckServer
classes.description: A no-op implementation of the HealthCheckServer interface that logs a warning on start and provides empty implementations for registering resources and stopping, always returning successful futures.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckResources
methods.description: Stub method for registering health check resources; intentionally does nothing.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Logs a warning indicating no health check is configured and returns a succeeded Future.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Returns a succeeded Future indicating successful stop.
